V1.4 ADMIN PANEL! FREE IN PRIVATE, PAID IN PUBLIC! Fixed bugs, improved mobile and optimization for everyone

Speedrun based game abt Baldi’s Basics in Education and Learning specifically ODIO EL CHOCOLATE MEME

OH NOES!

You accidentally brought a box of chocolates into his school, and now he's absolutely furious! Unfortunately, the chocolates have been scattered through out the school.

He saw you picking up the chocolate and thought you were going to throw it at him. That's why he's trying to chase you-he's traumatized by something that happened in the past.

Your goal is to find 13 chocolates in different rooms.

GOOD LUCK!
